query:
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.email, d.status, d.subscription_status, u.email as user_email
FROM dealers d
LEFT JOIN users u ON d.user_id = u.id
WHERE d.name LIKE '%realgrrt%' OR d.name LIKE '%grrt%' OR u.email LIKE '%realgrrt%'
LIMIT 10;
